_comment: Invented example. ExampleVendor and example-image-1 do not exist; the URLs are placeholders. Replace every value with what you found.

harvest.claim: The vendor publishes a model card for example-image-1 dated 2026-10.
The card reports one aggregate rate over adversarial prompts across all policy categories with the full safety stack on; no per-category rates and no stack-off baseline.

harvest.note: No evaluation of brand assets, forged documents, QR codes or likeness is mentioned.

harvest.claim: The usage policy prohibits impersonation and content intended to defraud; it does not say at which layer this is enforced.
The card states that outputs carry C2PA metadata and an invisible watermark, and that the detector is internal to the vendor.

harvest.note: No customer-side log of generations is documented.
